title: Structural surrogate of an OpenUSD asset: CalculiX + PhysicsNeMo FNO
description: The UR10 mounting pedestal of NVIDIA's OpenUSD content, read with OpenUSD and measured for its mounting interface, a four-variable design family solved by CalculiX, a 3-D FNO trained on the grid, the physics checks it passes, and a dashboard that answers the sliders live.
